occurrences.exact_quote:
| Figure or term | Distinguishing function | Critical separation |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Aion** | Eternal or cosmic duration; an age | Not automatically chronological succession |
| **Chronos** | Sequential or measurable time | Not automatically Cronus |
| **Cronus / Kronos** | Genealogical Titan and sovereign; later time-associated interpretations | Genealogy ≠ time function |
| **Kairos** | Opportune or decisive moment | Event condition, not necessarily duration |
| **Horos** | Boundary, limit, separation | Boundary operation, not simply another generation |
| **Mnemosyne** | Memory; mother of the nine Muses with Zeus | Memory transmitted through generation |
| **Mneme** | Remembrance or personified Memory | Similar function does not establish identical identity |
| **Phoebe** | Titaness associated with prophecy; mother of Leto with Coeus | Ancestral transmission to Apollo through Leto |
| **Metis** | Counsel, cunning intelligence; mother of Athena with Zeus | Intelligence and inheritance, not automatically memory |
| **Lethe** | Forgetfulness | Counterfunction to remembrance, not simply death |
| **Apollo** | Music, prophecy, and other functions | Functions acquired or expressed within a genealogy |
| **Hermes** | Interpretation, communication, transmission; associated with the lyre | Mediation across domains, not necessarily genealogical parentage |
